test_title: PYST 23: SSC JE EE- General Awareness (Held on: 22 March 2021 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: 2 members of the Lok Sabha are nominated by the Speaker of the Lok Sabha
12 members of the Rajya Sabha are nominated by the President.
4 members of the Lok Sabha are nominated by the President.
2 members of the Rajya Sabha are nominated by the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.

solution:
The correct answer is __**12 members of the Rajya Sabha are nominated by the President**__.

 
• **12 members **of the **Rajya Sabha** are **nominated by** the **President** of India.
 
• For** six-year term** for **their contributions** towards **arts, literature, sciences,** and **social services.**
 
• This right has been bestowed upon the President according to the **Fourth Schedule, Articles 4(1)** and **80(2)** of the **Constitution of India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64e177b3c5c5cb81c12b3d5b5ddabaaf474cdad3d6098992ca6592786c8147d6.png] 

 
• **Legislative Powers of President**

 
 
• He summons or prorogues Parliament and dissolve the Lok Sabha
 
• He summons a joint sitting of Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha in case of deadlock
 
• He addresses the Indian Parliament at the commencement of the first session after every general election
 
• He appoints a speaker, deputy speaker of Lok Sabha, and chairman/deputy chairman of Rajya Sabha when the seats fall vacant (to know the difference between Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha check the linked article.)
 
• **He nominates 12 members of the Rajya Sabha**
 
• He consults the Election Commission of India on questions of disqualifications of MPs.
 
• He recommends/ permits the introduction of certain types of bills (to read on how a bill is passed in the Indian Parliament, check the linked article.)
 
• He promulgates ordinances
 
• He lays the following reports before the Parliament:
 
 
• Comptroller and Auditor General
 
• Union Public Service Commission
 
• Finance Commission
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87c1a28e731fadd9279228c1cea2f8e988a3f790bf9ccc89c9b0f02c423b1609.png] 

 
• The Indian **President** is the **head of the state**.
 
• He is the **first citizen of India** and is a symbol of solidarity, unity, and integrity of the nation.
 
• **About ****president**
 
 
• **Article for President -** Article 52
 
• Article for Election of President- Article 54
 
• Article for Impeachment - Article 61
 
• Article for Pardon - Article 72
 
• Minimum Age - 35 Years
